chunks: From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman whose husband was tried (with impotence), so he was not able to perform sexual intercourse; can she separate from him? He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes, if she so desires.'
Ibn Muskan said, 'And in another Hadith: She waits for a year. If he comes to her, [the marriage continues], otherwise she separates from him. But if she loves to stay with him, let her stay.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for a wife if her husband is impotent?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* outlines the Shia jurisprudence regarding *al-'Uqr* (impotence), granting the wife the right to choose between waiting for a year to see if the husband recovers or initiating *Khul'* (separation). The narration highlights the balance between preserving the marital bond and preventing hardship (*darar*), reflecting the Imams' pragmatic approach to resolving sexual incompatibility in marriage. The option to remain if she wishes underscores the voluntary nature of continuing the union despite the physical limitation.

en.hubeali: From him, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who tried her husband, but he was not able upon the copulation, can she separate from him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, if she so desires it’.

Ibn Muskan (the narrator) said, ‘And in another Hadeeth, ‘(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘She would wait for a year. So if he comes to her, or else she separates from him. But, if she loves to stay with him, so let her stay’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Safwan ibn Yahya from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who tries her husband but he is not able to go to bed with her; if they must be separated from each other.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, if she wants separation.’

Ibn Muskan has said that in another Hadith he (the Imam) has said that she must wait for one year and if he still is not able to go to bed with her, she can leave him, but if she likes to stay with him she can do so.’”
